```{r run-enriched-analysis, include=FALSE}
# Run enriched population analysis for all model structures
# For each biomarker, compare experimental treatment vs control
# within the biomarker-positive subgroup only

model_configs_list <- list(
  list(structure = 0, label = "Model A"),
  list(structure = 1, label = "Model B"),
  list(structure = 2, label = "Model C")
)

biomarker_labels <- c(
  crp = "CRP-positive",
  tlr = "TLR-positive",
  tmb_braf = "TMB/BRAF-positive"
)

enriched_results <- data.frame()

for (mc in model_configs_list) {
  MODEL_STRUCTURE <<- mc$structure

  suppressMessages(suppressWarnings({
    source(here("scripts/R/analysis/06_parametric_survival_analysis.R"))
    source(here("scripts/R/analysis/07_basecase_input_parameters.R"))
  }))

  for (biomarker in names(biomarker_labels)) {
    # Get enriched population predictions from the predictions object
    if (!is.null(predictions[[biomarker]]$biomarker_positive)) {
      bm_pos_os <- predictions[[biomarker]]$biomarker_positive$os
      bm_pos_pfs <- predictions[[biomarker]]$biomarker_positive$pfs
    } else {
      next
    }

    # Control predictions for these patients
    ctrl_os <- predictions$control$os
    ctrl_pfs <- predictions$control$pfs

    # Run model for experimental treatment (enriched: only biomarker+ patients)
    params_exp <- l_params_base
    params_exp$p_os <- list(control_OS = ctrl_os)
    params_exp$p_pfs <- list(control_PFS = ctrl_pfs)

    # We need to compute outcomes for:
    # 1. Biomarker+ patients on experimental treatment
    # 2. Biomarker+ patients on control

    # Compute QALYs and costs directly from survival curves
    dr_costs <- l_params_base$dr_costs
    dr_effects <- l_params_base$dr_effects
    th <- l_params_base$time_horizon

    v_dw_c <- 1 / (1 + dr_costs)^(seq(0, th) / 52)
    v_dw_e <- 1 / (1 + dr_effects)^(seq(0, th) / 52)

    # Enriched experimental arm (biomarker+ on experimental treatment)
    exp_pf <- bm_pos_pfs
    exp_os <- bm_pos_os
    exp_p <- pmax(exp_os - exp_pf, 0)
    exp_d <- 1 - exp_os

    # Undiscounted QALYs
    exp_qaly_raw <- sum(exp_pf * l_params_base$u_np + exp_p * l_params_base$u_p) * l_params_base$cl
    # Discounted QALYs
    exp_qaly <- sum((exp_pf * l_params_base$u_np + exp_p * l_params_base$u_p) * v_dw_e) * l_params_base$cl

    # Costs for experimental arm
    exp_cost <- sum((
      l_params_base$l_nivo * l_params_base$c_drug_nivo +
      l_params_base$l_FLOX_exp * l_params_base$c_drug_FLOX +
      l_params_base$l_CT * l_params_base$c_test_CT +
      l_params_base$l_blood * l_params_base$c_test_blood +
      l_params_base$l_visit * l_params_base$c_other_visit
    ) * exp_pf * v_dw_c) * l_params_base$cl +
      l_params_base$c_other_baseline + l_params_base$c_other_last

    # Add biomarker test costs
    if (biomarker == "tmb_braf") {
      exp_cost <- exp_cost + l_params_base$c_test_NGS
    } else {
      exp_cost <- exp_cost + l_params_base$c_test_blood
    }

    # Enriched control arm (biomarker+ on control treatment)
    ctrl_pf <- ctrl_pfs
    ctrl_p <- pmax(ctrl_os - ctrl_pf, 0)
    ctrl_d_state <- 1 - ctrl_os

    ctrl_qaly <- sum((ctrl_pf * l_params_base$u_np + ctrl_p * l_params_base$u_p) * v_dw_e) * l_params_base$cl

    ctrl_cost <- sum((
      l_params_base$l_FLOX_control * l_params_base$c_drug_FLOX +
      l_params_base$l_CT * l_params_base$c_test_CT +
      l_params_base$l_blood * l_params_base$c_test_blood +
      l_params_base$l_visit * l_params_base$c_other_visit
    ) * ctrl_pf * v_dw_c) * l_params_base$cl +
      l_params_base$c_other_baseline + l_params_base$c_other_last

    # Incremental analysis
    inc_cost <- exp_cost - ctrl_cost
    inc_qaly <- exp_qaly - ctrl_qaly
    icer <- if (inc_qaly > 0) inc_cost / inc_qaly else NA

    enriched_results <- rbind(enriched_results, data.frame(
      Model = mc$label,
      Biomarker = biomarker_labels[biomarker],
      Treatment = "Experimental",
      Cost = exp_cost,
      QALYs = exp_qaly,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))

    enriched_results <- rbind(enriched_results, data.frame(
      Model = mc$label,
      Biomarker = biomarker_labels[biomarker],
      Treatment = "Control (FLOX)",
      Cost = ctrl_cost,
      QALYs = ctrl_qaly,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
}

cat("Enriched population results:", nrow(enriched_results), "rows\n")
```

```{r build-display-table, include=FALSE}
# Compute incremental results and ICERs
display_data <- enriched_results %>%
  group_by(Model, Biomarker) %>%
  summarise(
    Exp_Cost = Cost[Treatment == "Experimental"],
    Ctrl_Cost = Cost[Treatment == "Control (FLOX)"],
    Exp_QALY = QALYs[Treatment == "Experimental"],
    Ctrl_QALY = QALYs[Treatment == "Control (FLOX)"],
    Inc_Cost = Exp_Cost - Ctrl_Cost,
    Inc_QALY = Exp_QALY - Ctrl_QALY,
    ICER = ifelse(Inc_QALY > 0, Inc_Cost / Inc_QALY, NA),
    Status = ifelse(Inc_QALY <= 0 & Inc_Cost > 0, "Dominated",
             ifelse(Inc_QALY > 0, sprintf("\u20AC%s/QALY", format(round(ICER), big.mark = ",")),
                    "Dominant")),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r display-table}
display_fmt <- display_data %>%
  mutate(
    `Control Cost` = sprintf("\u20AC%s", format(round(Ctrl_Cost), big.mark = ",")),
    `Control QALYs` = sprintf("%.2f", Ctrl_QALY),
    `Experimental Cost` = sprintf("\u20AC%s", format(round(Exp_Cost), big.mark = ",")),
    `Experimental QALYs` = sprintf("%.2f", Exp_QALY),
    `Inc. Cost` = sprintf("\u20AC%s", format(round(Inc_Cost), big.mark = ",")),
    `Inc. QALYs` = sprintf("%.3f", Inc_QALY),
    ICER = Status
  ) %>%
  select(Model, Biomarker,
         `Control Cost`, `Control QALYs`,
         `Experimental Cost`, `Experimental QALYs`,
         `Inc. Cost`, `Inc. QALYs`, ICER)

kable(display_fmt,
      caption = "Table S6: Full cost-effectiveness results for biomarker-enriched populations across all model specifications",
      format = "html",
      align = c("l", "l", rep("r", 7))) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size = 11) %>%
  pack_rows(index = table(display_fmt$Model)) %>%
  footnote(
    general = c(
      "Enriched population analysis restricts cohort to biomarker-positive patients only.",
      "Compares experimental treatment (FLOX + nivolumab) vs. standard care (FLOX) within each biomarker-positive subgroup.",
      "Dominated = more costly and less effective. This is a ceiling analysis: no testing costs are included.",
      "Costs and QALYs discounted at 4% per year.",
      "Model A: All biomarkers + all interactions. Model B: CRP and TMB/BRAF with both interactions (TLR excluded as covariate). Model C: Single biomarker per model."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes: "
  )
```

if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) {

}

write.csv(display_data, file = here("tables", "table_s6.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
